title: Prayer
identity: There are two Donemus products. No. 20960 is the 2019 original for violin, alto saxophone and piano. No. 22176 is a December 2022 arrangement of that trio for violin, B-flat clarinet and piano. The current SaxoBrain research link points to 22176, while its instrument field names saxophone; use 20960 to support the saxophone scoring, and keep the edition mismatch visible.

evidence.claim: Donemus identifies the trio instrumentation, 2019 composition/revision, 8:30 duration, Kugoni Trio commission and the meditative, alternating melody with steady accompaniment.
Donemus also lists a 2021 revised version for violin, alto saxophone, piano and strings, originally commissioned for Kugoni Trio and Ataneres Ensemble.

Donemus 20960 is the 2019 original trio for violin, alto saxophone and piano, commissioned by Kugoni Trio; its seven-page public PDF preview includes the cover/copyright and score pages, of which the opening and a later passage were visually inspected.
evidence.page: PDF pp. 1–7; notation observations from score pages

evidence.claim: The current SaxoBrain link points to Donemus 22176, a December 2022 arrangement for violin, B-flat clarinet and piano of the 2019 saxophone/violin/piano trio; the four-page preview visibly shows those three instruments.

score_observations: The 20960 public preview opens in 6/4 at quarter=64 with violin and alto saxophone resting while the piano sustains a softly marked bell-like texture. At section C, bar 9, saxophone enters in a quiet sustained, slurred phrase marked quasi senza vibrato and dolcissimo espressivo. A later preview page continues with long tied tones and sparse entrances against repeated piano arpeggiated figures. These observations apply to the saxophone version 20960, not the clarinet arrangement 22176.
review_focus: Confirm the intended saxophone edition is Donemus 20960; its preview shows the saxophone entering after a piano opening and later sharing a sustained, quiet lyrical line with violin.
collection_flag: Donemus states the original 2019 saxophone/violin/piano trio was commissioned by Kugoni Trio. Donemus 22176 is a later clarinet arrangement; the 20960 source also names a CD release Essence (2019).

listening.description: Donemus lists the 2019 work on Kugoni Trio’s CD Essence.
listening.verification: Release listing verified; no audio playback auditioned.

score_links.description: Donemus public POST preview, seven-page PDF including cover/copyright and five score pages; title, performance notes, opening and later notation inspected.
Donemus public preview for 2022 violin/clarinet/piano arrangement; cover text and opening notation visually inspected.

gaps: The 20960 preview does not show the complete part; full written range and saxophone transposition remain unknown. No college-level placement claim was established.
The current linked Donemus product, 22176, is the clarinet arrangement; verify the intended product for this saxophone catalog entry.
